name: Knock On Wood Furniture
old_description: Knock On Wood is a family owned and operated business located in Smithfield, Rhode Island.
about:
Knock On Wood Furniture is a family-owned and operated business based in Smithfield, Rhode Island. Founded in 1988, the company has served the Blackstone Valley area for over three decades.

The company specializes in finished and unfinished solid wood furniture, offering pieces such as desks, entertainment centers, bedroom sets, dining room sets, kitchen chairs, tables, cabinets, and pantries. It provides custom finishing services, including a wide range of stain and paint colors with color-matching capabilities. The business operates a showroom where customers can browse products.

Knock On Wood Furniture primarily serves residential customers in the Blackstone Valley region, supplying furniture for kitchens, bedrooms, and dining rooms. Its customer base includes homeowners and possibly local retailers, though the company emphasizes direct showroom sales.

The company highlights its long-standing local presence and custom finishing flexibility as key differentiators, though it does not explicitly state a founding mission beyond serving the community.
